environment.description: Lambda function deployed with function URL configured with auth_type=AWS_IAM. The resource-based policy on the function URL specifies a principal condition (aws:PrincipalOrgID) restricting invocation to identities within the organization. No public invoke permission is granted. Callers without valid SigV4 signatures matching an authorized IAM principal receive HTTP 403 from the Lambda service endpoint before the function code executes. Note: the code itself has no authentication logic — the gate is entirely at the Lambda service layer for function URL invocation authorization.
